proved: The Rust-owned request targets exactly stable /v1/interactions, uses x-goog-api-key without bearer authorization, sends stream:true plus Accept:text/event-stream, and retains store:false, background:false, and thinking_summaries:none.
The transport requires text/event-stream, enforces the shared 32 MiB aggregate ceiling, and remains inside the existing absolute request timeout and caller cancellation future.

The incremental decoder normalizes interaction.created, bounded unique indexed step start/delta/stop events, initial and delta model-output text, final usage/status, sanitized errors/warnings, and [DONE].
Thought summaries, thought signatures, function/tool names, and argument deltas are represented only by content-free warning types; their bodies never enter normalized events.
Orphan or duplicate steps, unfinished steps, mismatched interaction IDs, label/type mismatch, inconsistent usage, malformed frames, and incomplete terminal lifecycle fail closed.

The native task runtime accumulates a bounded Gemini response, removes the cancellation registration, marks the content-free run record as streamed, and excludes secret, prompt, category, and thought canaries.
The workspace remote-review routing selects native streaming for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini while leaving xAI on bounded one-shot generation.
notProved: A live Gemini credential, endpoint response, model ID, rate limit, billing behavior, or provider-policy behavior.
Function/tool argument assembly, schema validation, tool execution, or thought-signature continuation.
Retry, reconnect, event resumption, duplicate-event, slow-consumer, or backpressure behavior.
Packaged native Send once dialog interaction or a shipped updater artifact containing this checkpoint.
Any model-quality, truth, consensus, or superiority property.
